title: FlowReconBench: Accuracy, calibration and cost of learned and classical flow reconstruction from sparse sensors
abstract: arXiv:2611.06912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing full flow fields from sparse sensors requires prior assumptions about unmeasured regions and physical variables. Yet it remains unclear when learned models outperform classical estimators and which aspects of their predictions can be trusted. FlowReconBench evaluates ten learned and five classical methods on three regimes: a laminar cylinder wake across Reynolds numbers, two-dimensional Kolmogorov turbulence and a large-scale three-dimensional (3D) isotropic turbulence. Methods share leakage-controlled splits and sensor draws and are scored on per-channel error, ensemble spread, calibration, spectra and cost. The leading method changes for each regime. Classical methods perform strongly in low-order and dense-sensing regimes. translated_title: FlowReconBench：基于稀疏传感器的学习型与经典流场重构方法的精度、校准与成本
translated_abstract: 从稀疏传感器重构完整流场需要对未测量区域和物理变量做出先验假设。然而，学习型模型何时优于经典估计器，以及其预测中哪些方面是可信的，目前仍不清楚。FlowReconBench 在三种流动状态下评估了十种学习型方法和五种经典方法：跨雷诺数变化的层流圆柱尾流、二维 Kolmogorov 湍流以及大规模三维（3D）各向同性湍流。所有方法采用统一的防泄漏数据划分与传感器采样配置，并按照逐通道误差、集成离散度、校准性、能谱和计算成本进行评分。最优方法随流动状态而变化：经典方法在低阶流动和密集传感场景下表现强劲；在圆柱尾流问题上，线性随机估计和带缺失数据的本征正交分解（gappy POD）方法领先，包括对未观测压力的重构；在三维情况下，逆距离加权方法可与最佳学习型方法相媲美。
tldr: 本文提出 FlowReconBench 基准，系统评估了学习型与经典稀疏传感器流场重构方法在三种流动状态下的精度、校准与成本，发现最优方法因流动状态而异，且经典方法在低阶流动和密集传感场景下表现强劲。
en_tdlr: FlowReconBench benchmarks ten learned and five classical flow reconstruction methods from sparse sensors across three flow regimes, revealing that the leading method varies by regime and classical methods remain strongly competitive in low-order and dense-sensing scenarios.
